facts.fact: 她把Levi留在公寓的衣物借给Carson（两人同尺码）
facts.anchor: Levi left some of his things here the last time he stayed with me.

facts.fact: 留宿的官方理由：反正也会熬夜互发短信
facts.anchor: We both know that if you go back to the hotel, we’ll just stay up late texting each other anyway.

facts.fact: 她暗自承诺：尽快向Levi坦白这段友谊
facts.anchor: And I promised myself I’d find a way to talk to Levi about my friendship with Carson—soon.

facts.fact: 灰卫衣梗：I watched women’s hockey before it was cool 是Levi在挪威冬奥时定制
facts.anchor: Levi had it made when I played in the Winter Olympics in Norway.

facts.fact: Carson情报：Levi一直以她为傲、想成为她
facts.anchor: “He’s always been so proud of you,” Carson said. “Wanted to be just like you.”

facts.fact: 她发现Carson提家人总用过去时
facts.anchor: it was always in the past tense.

facts.fact: 他不敢碰非自己赢来的金牌（运动员迷信）
facts.anchor: I wouldn’t touch the Stanley unless I’d won it. Maybe it’s bad luck to touch a gold medal that isn’t yours.

facts.fact: 五环纹身描摹到腰际，救护车警笛打破魔咒
facts.anchor: But then the wail of an ambulance sounded in the distance, and he took a deep breath and withdrew.

facts.fact: 奥运名单话题触发grief突袭：Derek本该在队里
facts.anchor: “I was just thinking of how Derek would’ve—should’ve—been on that team.”

facts.fact: 她猜Carson初期难融入：他是被招来顶Derek的
facts.anchor: Hell, he’d been brought on to the Hawks to replace Derek.

facts.fact: Derek像兄长/导师：教她transitions，她帮他过哲学课
facts.anchor: He’d helped me master transitions, and I’d helped him ace our philosophy course.

facts.fact: Carson助攻史：与Gabe十小时搭 pergola（Anguilla惊喜）
facts.anchor: Gabe and I spent ten hours building that fucking pergola.

facts.fact: 结尾：她在他身边睡着，五个月来最有安全感的一夜
facts.anchor: I couldn’t remember the last time I’d felt more safe or more seen by someone.
